_about: Chatbot messages in English. Keys ending in '.ussd' are short versions for feature phones (one USSD screen holds about 182 characters). Placeholders in {curly brackets} are filled in by the chatbot.
welcome:
Welcome to Report EC 👋
Wamkelekile ku-Report EC.

Choose a language / Khetha ulwimi:
1. English
2. isiXhosa
menu.header: What would you like to do?
ask_description:
Please describe the problem in your own words.
For example: "A water pipe has burst near the clinic."
ussd.type_problem: Type the problem in a few words:
description_missing: I didn't receive a description. Please type a few words about the problem.
description_too_short: Please tell me a little more, for example what is broken and what is happening.
media_without_text: Thank you for the photo 📷. Please also describe the problem in words.
too_long: That message is very long. Please keep it under {max_chars} characters.
unsupported_message: Sorry, I can only read text messages, photos and location pins.
clarify_category: I'm not sure what kind of problem this is. Please choose the closest option:
safety.electrical: ⚠️ Stay away from the wires and keep children away. Do not touch anything connected to them.
safety.fire: ⚠️ Keep away from the fire or smoke.
safety.open_manhole: ⚠️ Keep children away from the open manhole and warn others to walk around it.
safety.flooding: ⚠️ Keep away from fast-flowing water and switch off electrical appliances that may get wet, if it is safe to do so.
safety.sewage: ⚠️ Avoid touching sewage water and keep children away from it.
safety.road: ⚠️ Please take care near the damaged road.
safety.footer: If anyone is hurt or in immediate danger, call 112 from a cellphone or 10177 (ambulance and fire). This chat does NOT alert emergency services.
safety.footer.ussd: In danger? Call 112. This is not an emergency line.
ask_location:
Where is the problem? Send the area or suburb and a nearby landmark, for example: "Zwide, near the clinic".
You can also share your location pin 📍.
ask_location.ussd: Type the area and a landmark, e.g. Zwide near clinic:
location_need_area: Thank you. Which area or suburb is that in? (for example Zwide, KwaZakhele or Motherwell)
location_missing: I still need to know where the problem is so the team can find it. Please type the area name or a nearby landmark, or share your location pin 📍.
location_missing.ussd: Please type the area or a landmark:
location_accepted_as_written: Thank you. I will send the location exactly as you wrote it. Municipal staff may need to confirm it.
ask_ward: Do you know the ward number? Reply with the number, or 0 if you don't know.
ward_invalid: Please reply with a ward number from 1 to {max_ward}, or 0 if you don't know.
ask_evidence: If you have a photo of the problem, send it now. Otherwise reply 0 to skip.
evidence_invalid: Please send a photo, or reply 0 to skip.
evidence_unsupported_type: Sorry, I can only accept photos (JPEG, PNG or WEBP). Please send a photo, or reply 0 to skip.
edit.header: What would you like to change?
submitted:
✅ Your report has been submitted to Report EC.
Reference number: *{reference}*
Keep this number to check progress. Type *menu* for more options.
submitted.ussd: Report sent. Ref: {reference}. Keep this number to check progress.
already_submitted:
This report was already submitted. Reference number: *{reference}*
Type *menu* for more options.
submission_failed: ❌ Sorry, we could not submit your report right now. It has NOT been sent and there is no reference number yet. Your details are still saved.
cancelled: Your report was cancelled and nothing was sent. Send any message to start again.
help:
Report EC help:
• *menu* – main menu
• *back* – previous step
• *cancel* – stop the current report
• *restart* – start again
• *language* – change language

Report EC sends your report to the municipality. It is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call 112 from a cellphone.
help.ussd: Report EC sends reports to the municipality. Not an emergency line: call 112.
invalid_choice: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Please reply with one of the numbers shown.
invalid_choice_repeated: It looks like this step is difficult. You can type *help* at any time, or *menu* to start again.
back_not_possible: There is no previous step here.
ask_reference: Please send your reference number (for example EC-1042).
ask_reference_with_last: Please send your reference number. Your last report was *{reference}*: reply 1 to check that one.
reference_invalid: That doesn't look like a reference number. It looks like EC-1042. Please try again, or type *menu*.
reference_invalid.ussd: Not a valid reference. e.g. EC-1042:
status_not_found: I couldn't find a report with that number linked to this phone number. Please check the number and try again.
status_not_found.ussd: No report found for this number.
status_unavailable: Sorry, I can't check the status right now. Please try again later.
status_verify_hint: You can tell us if it is really fixed: choose *Confirm or dispute a repair* in the menu.
status.submitted.label: Submitted
status.submitted.explain: Your report has been received and is waiting for the municipality to look at it.
status.acknowledged.label: Acknowledged
status.acknowledged.explain: The municipality has seen your report and is arranging a team.
status.in_progress.label: In progress
status.in_progress.explain: A municipal team is working on the problem.
status.pending_verification.label: Fix claimed – waiting for community confirmation
status.pending_verification.explain: The municipality says the problem has been fixed. It is not closed until residents confirm it.
status.verified_resolved.label: Verified resolved
status.verified_resolved.explain: The repair was checked through the verification process and the report is closed.
status.disputed.label: Disputed
status.disputed.explain: Residents said the problem is not fixed. The municipality must review it.
status.reopened.label: Reopened
status.reopened.explain: The report was reopened because the problem was not fixed or came back.
status.unknown.label: Unknown
status.unknown.explain: The status could not be explained. Please contact the municipality.
verify.ask_reference: Which report do you want to confirm or dispute? Please send the reference number (for example EC-1042).
verify.intro:
The municipality says this problem has been fixed:
"{claim}"

Is it really fixed?
verify.intro.ussd: Municipality says {reference} is fixed. Is it?
verify.intro_no_claim: The municipality says report {reference} has been fixed. Is it really fixed?
verify.option.dispute: No, the problem is still there
verify.not_open: Report {reference} is not waiting for community confirmation right now. Its status is: {status_label}.
verify.ask_details: Please tell us what you see now. You can also send a photo. Reply 0 to skip.
verify.recorded: Thank you. Your response has been recorded for report {reference}. It will be reviewed with other residents' responses before a final decision is made. This message does not close the report.
verify.recorded.ussd: Thank you. Your response for {reference} was recorded for review.
verify.failed: ❌ Sorry, we could not record your response right now. It has NOT been saved.
resume_prompt:
Welcome back. You have an unfinished report:
"{description}"
